_about: Puzzle Maker's public launch day (Jorge, Nov 13, 2026: no launch day yet). null = every Daily is an unranked preview (no game numbers; badge receipts only from the badges day below) and every page is noindex (hoopsmatic-worker PUZZLE_MAKER_LAUNCH, set the same moment there). Set launch to 'YYYY-MM-DD' (9:00 AM ET) to switch on game numbers (#1 = that day), ranked boards and badges by themselves. start: the first data-built Daily lock. badges: the day badge receipts start (Jorge, Nov 13, 2026: on before launch); null = from launch. scripts/build.mjs copies launch and badges to public/config.json, which the page and the server read.
